title: Evaluation of the implementation of a computerized physician order entry (CPOE) system with integrated clinical decision support system (CDSS)
summary: A CPOE system with integrated CDSS is currently being implemented at Heidelberg University Hospital, as is the case at many other German hospitals. The purpose of this study is to evaluate the effects of such an implementation. To achieve this, different evaluation methods are applied, which among others assess process changes, time efficiency, prescription quality and user opinion. Analyses of the data documented during the patients' hospital stay, as well as observations, interviews and questionnaire surveys of the healthcare staff are applied. The aim of the study is to objectify the effects of the CPOE implementation in order to be able to take further measures towards improving the system and its usage.
conditions: Quality, effort and process of patient-specific data documentation during the inpatient hospital stay
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Included people are:
- involved in patient care at the University Hospital Heidelberg or at other hospitals (e.g., physicians, nurses, pharmacists, physiotherapists, social workers),
- working at a general ward that is implementing or has implemented the CPOE system.
Exclusion criteria:
none
